name: Commons
tagline: A map-first platform where residents report needs, AI scores urgency transparently and matches resources.

awards: [MLH] Best Domain Name from GoDaddy Registry

problem: Community organisations fail from fragmented signals, not lack of care.
solution: Residents report issues on a map; urgency scoring shows weighted factors; needs are matched to nearby resources and volunteers.
demo_moment: Team-described: report a need and see it matched.
